description: Adventure just found another gear. Introducing the GVR. Because fast is fun. In the pursuit of more speed (and more fun) on dirt, gravel, and pavement, we sought every advantage: better aerodynamics, lighter weight, more stiffness, and exceptional comfort. We wanted to give you no excuses—whether on race day or your weekend romp. We wanted hidden cables, ample tire clearance, and precise handling. In short, we wanted it all—and we found it in the GVRThe wild spirit of gravel sends many of us down unknown backroads and trails in the pursuit of adventure. But many of us also seek speed and performance, hunting for the edge of our capabilities. So our product design team created a gravel bike with the traits that performance-hungry riders want and the toughness to handle almost any terrain. With OBED, you can customize your build more than any other brand. Choose from Shimano or SRAM drivetrains, alloy or carbon wheels, 650b or 700c wheel and tire combos, the exact components you desire, and even a new color-blocked range of frame, fork, and graphic color options. Build your dream gravel bike from the ground up. When you customize a GVR, no two are alike—it’s built just for you. Learn More about the GVR This Bike Is For You If... Finding your wild side includes a lot of race-day action. While the GVR has everything you need for the weekend adventure with friends, the nimble handling, low weight, and aerodynamic design position it neatly for performance-oriented riding. The GVR is engineered for high-speed riding on tough courses. If you like to attack steep and punchy climbs, carve through loose corners, and fly off the front of a fast group, the GVR is for you.
